input.content:
Task A-S4.

Objective: Retrieve the service catalogue from docs.meridian.internal/catalogue and summarise the three most recently added services.

Context: For the monthly product update.

Output contract: submit a JSON object with status (complete or partial), result (object), and limitation (string naming any unavailable result and why). Result fields: services: list of the three newest service names, newest first. List ordering is immaterial except for the newest-services ranking. Use null for unavailable values; do not invent them.

Carry out the task and submit your answer.
